title: Autonomous repo bugfix scan pass 3
summary: Fixed validation blockers found during an autonomous scan: normalized a prior packet status enum, refreshed stale generated WebView/test inventories, aligned stale WebView static assertions with the current latestQueue handoff, tokenized the operator toast CSS, and made the queue source tile ARIA guard robust in DOM smoke harnesses.
reason: Broad tooling, desktop, and WebView validation exposed high-confidence drift and one WebView runtime smoke edge. The fixes keep backend ownership and safety boundaries intact while restoring generated-context, WebView prework, desktop, tooling, and WebView test coverage.
behavior_before: Change-control validation was blocked by an invalid prior packet status; duplicate-test and WebView generated reports were stale; several WebView static tests still expected the old values.queue fallback instead of latestQueue; operator-toast CSS bypassed design tokens; and queueView assumed hasAttribute existed in DOM smoke elements, causing row-detail and diagnostics-owner smoke failures.
behavior_after: Change-control metadata uses the allowed complete status, generated reports match the current source/test inventory, WebView static tests pin the latestQueue handoff and failure cleanup command owner, toast styles use existing tokens, and queue source tile rendering preserves ARIA labels without crashing non-browser DOM smoke elements.
manual_validation: mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check - passed after explicit operator-toast summary refresh
python -m unittest discover -s tests/python/tooling -q -b - passed, 191 tests
python -m unittest discover -s tests/python/desktop -q -b - passed, 2335 tests, 1 skipped
python -m unittest discover -s tests/python/core -q -b - passed, 105 tests
python -m unittest discover -s tests/webview -q -b - passed, 229 tests
targeted WebView failures for CSS tokens, diagnostics owner handoff, mutation-boundary ownership, Libraries latestQueue assertion, and row-detail smoke - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the packet status normalization, generated-report refreshes, WebView test assertion updates, queueView ARIA guard, and operator-toast tokenization, then rerun refresh_summaries and the same tooling/desktop/WebView validation ladder. No media-operation, publish, rename, source, scratch, or backend mutation policy code was changed.
